summary: Carried two lower-bound attempts to explicit quantitative obstructions. Route 1 retains the corrected moving endpoints and derives G(N)=S(N)*(N-B_N)+O_N(N^theta)+O_A(N/log(N)^A), theta<1/2, from the exact squarefree divisor split, ordinary BV and inspected unconditional coefficient evaluations. The remaining signed operator O_N is defined by weighted reflected-Mobius AP discrepancies; a one-sided bound above -(1-kappa)*S(N)*(1-A(N))*N would imply ordinary sufficiently-large Goldbach. The target gap can shrink, and its guaranteed size is only order 1/log(N)^2; a single maximal twisted saving beyond log^-3 at level N^(1-theta) would suffice but remains unproved. Direct absolute-value control gives only O(N log(N)^3). Route 2 computes the near-cubic lower-sieve parameter s=1/(2alpha)-o(1)<2 and the missing power level; FI instead requires D>N^(2/3) plus an explicit reflected-prime Mobius bilinear bound, neither supplied by ordinary BV. No actual parity-sensitive lower estimate or Goldbach breakthrough was obtained. The derivations await separate critic review, and the alternative weighted route does not automatically prove the stronger original rough F target.

claims.text: The endpoint-corrected signed-operator identity (8) follows from the exact divisor split, ordinary BV and the explicitly inspected unconditional coefficient estimates, with target and endpoint dependence retained.

The specified one-sided operator bound (O-open), or the stronger fixed-log-saving twisted discrepancy input (T-open), would imply Goldbach for all sufficiently large even N; neither input is proved here.

For the near-cubic cutoff the ordinary BV distribution level gives lower-sieve parameter below 2, while the specialized FI route additionally requires level above 2/3 and an unproved reflected-prime bilinear estimate.
An unconditional lower margin for F_alpha sufficient to dominate the proved contamination, and any Goldbach solution or breakthrough, remain unestablished.
